assets.temple_exterior.png: Outdoor Golden Temple approach: open twilight navy sky, distant gilded temple silhouettes and mountain valley; subdued painterly Gothic game backdrop. No foreground platforms or text.
assets.temple_interior.png: Enclosed Golden Temple hall: dark navy stone walls, gilded arches, carved pilasters, shadowed recesses, warm gold trim; no sky or outdoor landscape, no platforms or text.
assets.temple_masonry.png: Golden ashlar masonry texture with warm highlights, dark recessed joints and carved aged stone surfaces.
assets.temple_column.png: Isolated fluted gold classical temple column with broad carved capital, straight shaft and transparent surroundings.
assets.temple_boulder.png: Compact irregular golden stone boulder, deep crevices, readable round silhouette, transparent background.
assets.temple_gargoyle.png: Golden flying gargoyle matching the native reference silhouette: long head, two wings, bent legs, curled tail; transparent background.
assets.temple_gargoyle_alt.png: Alternate wingbeat of the same golden gargoyle; preserve the head, torso, colors and proportions.
assets.temple_guardian.png: Compact ivory and muted olive horned guardian matching the native irregular footprint, skeletal armored forms; transparent background.
assets.overdrive_orb.png: Compact cobalt blue and ivory magical spiked ring/orb, bright pale core, restrained gold rim and transparent background.
assets.temple_wave.png: Narrow tall crescent wave shaped like a left parenthesis, ivory core, gold and cyan edging; transparent background.

note: The Overdrive cast is 0A8A–0A8D. The narrow CB–CF crescent is the gargoyle attack; separate input tests established this identity.
